title: Installation Jobs Price Book: Site Condition Rates
content:
This price book page lists the per-unit rate figures for conditions found or requested at the home on **Installation Jobs**: rotted framing or sill, stucco or mortar patching, storm window removal, window treatments left up, and work above the first floor.

## Rot repair

| Installation method | Linear feet of rotted framing or sill replaced per opening at no charge | Rate per linear foot beyond the included footage (USD) | Rot repair beyond the included footage done only after the customer approves it on site |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 0 | 18.00 | Yes |
| Full-Frame Installation | 2 | 18.00 | Yes |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 2 | 22.00 | Yes |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 0 | 26.00 | Yes |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 4 | 28.00 | Yes |
| Door System Installation | 3 | 24.00 | Yes |

## Per-opening condition rates (USD)

| Installation method | Stucco or mortar patch around a masonry opening | Removal and disposal of an existing storm window | Taking down blinds, shades or curtains left up | Surcharge for an opening above the first floor reached by ladder or lift |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 0.00 | 15.00 | 12.00 | 0.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation | 0.00 | 15.00 | 12.00 | 25.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 0.00 | 15.00 | 12.00 | 25.00 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 85.00 | 15.00 | 12.00 | 35.00 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 0.00 | 25.00 | 12.00 | 75.00 |
| Door System Installation | 0.00 | 0.00 | 12.00 | 0.00 |

## Notes to the page

1. The included rot footage is a per-opening allowance; the rate in the second column applies per linear foot.
2. The stucco or mortar patch figure is 0.00 for every method other than Masonry Opening Installation.
3. The window-treatment figure is the same 12.00 per opening under every method.

## Reading the page (hypothetical example)

Under a hypothetical Bay and Bow Installation job, 4 linear feet of rotted framing or sill per opening are replaced at no charge, footage beyond that is priced at 28.00 per linear foot, and an opening above the first floor carries a 75.00 surcharge figure.
